title: There is no way to display the search query in currentRefinedValues while `onlyListedAttributes: true`
body:
<!--
  Thanks for participating in this project! We will try to answer as soon as possible 🙏
-->

**Describe the bug 🐛**
The search query is not shown in the *currentRefinedValues* widget when `onlyListedAttributes` is set to true.

**To Reproduce 🔍**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Go to https://codesandbox.io/s/8y2jrkz8o9
2. Filter by brand and see the brand is shown in the *currentRefinedValues* widget.
3. Enter a custom search query
4. See error, the search query is not displayed in the *currentRefinedValues* widget.

**Expected behavior 💭**
The search query should show up in the *currentRefinedValues* widget even when whitelisting the other shown attributes with `onlyListedAttributes: true`. If not by default, we should have a way of enabling it.

_Originally posted by @stianmartinsen in https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/2414#issuecomment-430514274_
